FROM wcebf292c_c946c5fafd152_pg.public.lineitem AS lineitem
LEFT JOIN wcebf292c_c946c5fafd152_pg.public.orders AS orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey

ORDER BY time_bucket ASC NULLS LAST
